Ines Fujin's debut race is here, and<n>her younger
twin sisters have come<n>to show their support.
She's the very<n>definition of a responsible older
sister.

Encouraged by a cute dance<n>performance from her
sisters, Ines<n>Fujin feels ready to make them<n>proud
and do her best!

There's no telling what will happen in<n>the race
ahead. With her heart<n>pounding, Ines Fujin is about
to make<n>her debut!
